## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      8 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 12 mai 2026 - 3 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _njbrandon_, 3 août 2026, 2/5: "Interactions 😔 for notes do not work. Reached out to fix but no response. When the little face icon is selected to bring up intersections for a note, shows “No results found” so need to reply instead. Also when notification is selected, doesn’t always open the task card. Few months back this was totally broken but eventually was fixed but now it’s sometimes broken. Progress"
            2. _JadedMind_, 23 juil. 2026, 2/5: "I can no longer log into this app on my phone, which makes it useless. No matter what I click, including contacting support, I get a message saying it can’t connect to the server. I don’t have this issue with any other app on my phone."
            3. _guymanstuff_, 9 juil. 2026, 3/5: "Can you please list in the release notes what you are actually fixing instead of just “we are making the app awesome for you” or “bye bye bugs”?"
